DICOM VIEWER  —  QUICK REFERENCE
================================

MOUSE
  Drag (W/L tool)       Adjust window/level
  Drag (Pan tool)       Pan image
  Drag (Zoom tool)      Drag down = zoom in, up = zoom out
  Middle-mouse drag     Pan (works in any tool)
  Ctrl/⌘ + scroll       Zoom
  Scroll wheel          Next / previous slice
  Click cell            Select cell
  Drag series → cell    Load that series into that cell
  Right-click metadata  Copy value / tag / name

KEYBOARD
  Page Up / Page Down   Previous / next slice
  ←  →                  Previous / next slice
  Home / End            First / last slice

TOOLS
  W/L   Window-level adjustment (default)
  PAN   Translate the image
  ZOOM  Scale the image
  LEN   Length measurement (2 clicks, mm if pixel spacing present)
  ANG   Angle (3 clicks: side · vertex · side)
  ROI ▭ Rectangle ROI with mean / std / min / max
  ROI ◯ Ellipse ROI

VIEW
  Cycle layouts in the toolbar (1×1 … 4×4).
  Toggle the study browser and metadata panel in the View menu.
  Use Reset View on the active cell to undo pan/zoom/rotate/window.

WINDOW PRESETS
  Soft tissue   C= 40   W= 400
  Lung          C=-600  W=1500
  Bone          C=300   W=1500
  Brain         C= 40   W=  80
  Abdomen       C= 60   W= 400
  Mediastinum   C= 50   W= 350
